item.title: Have you ever touched chaos?
item.description: Have you ever touched chaos? The sense that the universe stretches before you to oblivion, realising we are but a feather in a hurricane. We try to introduce order. Language, with its finite characters and vocabulary. Music, with its rhythms and repetition. But in the end, we’re all trying to make sense of something that cannot be made sense of. The void is senseless. We fall so far short of comprehending universal truth.
